packageRules.description: Astro and its Vite toolchain move together; one PR, one build to verify.
The design system is ours. Take it promptly so the site does not drift from m7kni.io.

TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and does not ship the programmatic API `astro check` is built on; @astrojs/language-server refuses to run and says to stay on 6.x. Lift this when withastro/roadmap#1321 lands, not before.
